definitions.explanation: A metal fitting used to hold things together or keep something closed, such as clasps on bags, latches on gates, or buckles on belts.

examples.japanese: ⟦バッグ→バッグ：00008_baggu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{留|と}め{金|がね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧。
examples.english: The clasp on my bag broke.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネックレス→ネックレス：04539_nekkuresu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{留|と}め{金|がね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}して→外す：02394_hazusu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please undo the clasp on the necklace.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{留|と}め{金|がね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧さびて⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦{門|もん}→門：14603_mon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|あ}かなく→開く：00689_aku⟧⟦なっていた→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The old latch was rusted and the gate wouldn't open.

notes:
A general term for metal fastening devices such as clasps, latches, hooks, and buckles. Can refer to any small metal mechanism that holds things together or keeps something shut.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {留|と}め{金|がね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to undo a clasp
- {留|と}め{金|がね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|し}める→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧: to fasten a clasp
- {留|と}め{金|がね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れる→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧: the clasp breaks

- {金具|かなぐ}: metal fittings (broader term)
